BiblicalUsage: The word is a washing, a cleansing, and it appears once, in the picture of the newborn Jerusalem: in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee, nor salted at all.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the washing is the mercy: God found a child unwashed and unloved, and He washed her and took her for His own.
